title: 卡莎·紫甲远台
description: 卡莎穿完整紫色生体衣静立开阔石台，双肩甲壳收拢，长发与面纹清楚，冷暖侧光显出利落轮廓。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Kai'Sa is an adult woman with long dark violet hair, violet cheek markings, alert purple eyes, and two distinctive curved living shoulder pods. Preserve the organic purple carapace silhouette with a fully opaque high-neck long-sleeved bodysuit, covered legs, gloves, and boots, without exposed chest or midriff. The shoulder pods stay folded and inactive, and her posture is composed rather than predatory.
art_direction.scene: Frame her in an upright three-quarter stance on a very broad stone terrace, arms lowered and shoulders settled, looking toward distant layered ridges. Keep the two pods separate from her head and arms. A hard amber rim and cool frontal side light break purple armor into coarse wax-crayon planes, while an immense open sky and sparse monoliths provide depth without threat.
art_direction.palette: deep violet, slate blue, lavender edge, pale amber
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
